items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: And, well, we had Arthur Durbney and Herb Hall, those are the original members, Alvin Martin.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's his boy. And, well, we had Arthur Durbney and Herb Hall, those are the original members, Alvin Martin. No one with a great education by no reason. But they were very intelligent and very well behaved. Beautiful. Beautiful. Everyone I meet from that band. Well, they didn't, one thing, they didn't drink. I didn't have one in that I could consider a drinker.

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: Orpidermy with his model T-fold and playing Jack Ebert with his Dodge

ctx.x: They were all available, but how many wanted to leave?

That was the problem. So finally, after you get the amount that you want. It was lucky enough that there were enough automobiles to leave. In those days, everybody didn't have an automobile like today. Orpidermy with his model T-fold and playing Jack Ebert with his Dodge and Don Alvigotis Chrysler. That's a convertible.
I know you didn't understand about Richard McCarty and Richard Johnson. What happened there after the job was taken?
